notes: The list test scans metadata but never populates wildcard_dict, which get_wildcard_list reads.

The lazy mode tests import modules.impact.config while wildcards imports impact.config. The tests also rely on untracked >1 MB custom wildcard data and a cached imported wildcard_dict that wildcard_load replaces.
Candidate and Main produce eight passes and the same three failures. No assertions or trusted fixtures were changed.

source_integrity.explanation: Only shared test browser setup gained Escape to dismiss initial template browser. Production code and both fixed catalog fixtures are byte-identical to the tested snapshot.

triage.initial: Template browser overlay intercepted new-workflow click.
triage.resolution: Shared helper now dismisses the initial overlay; full standalone wildcard script and three shared-helper tests passed. Production files unchanged.

triage.initial: 19 passed, one UI node-search timeout before product assertions in Encode/positional subgraph case.
triage.resolution: The same case passed with original coordinates and assertions on an isolated CPU cache-classic server. Named case passed in the original GPU run. No retry or assertion weakening added to tests; timing cause unproven.

triage.initial: Runner exited with SIGTERM (143) after 72 completed passes, no final pytest XML.
triage.resolution: Recorded completed node IDs; resumed exactly the 21 unfinished cases. Cause of SIGTERM unknown.
Same three failures and assertion messages reproduced on Main. Kept as outstanding legacy failures.

triage.initial: Six failures before editor behavior: globally observed deprecated /scripts/ui.js import.
triage.cause: Inspire Pack js/regional.js imports ../../scripts/ui.js. This global import check requires an Impact-only server.
triage.resolution: Unchanged six-case suite rerun against isolated Impact-only CPU server; see legacy-sam-isolated-browser.xml.

limits: Full AnimateDiff video inference is not covered; assembly tensors and original tutorial native restoration are covered.
Only the installed frontend version and current hardware are covered; the merged Main integration tree was not executed.
The issue report supplied no original workflow; dedicated regression uses the reproduced dynamic-output native-loading path.
Historical fixture-dependent shell diagnostics are not counted as successful regression assertions.
Native loading of original wildcard/AnimateDiff tutorials does not imply execution of their unrelated plugins. SDXLPromptStyler and BNK inference were not run.

totals.counting: Rerun successes replace failed attempts in maintained pass totals. Four additional LRU executions count separately from classic cache. Three shared-harness tests count once. Baseline runs are excluded. Initial failures and the interrupted run remain in detailed records.

supplemental_screenshot_evidence.validation: Same baseline workflow loaded, natively exported and reloaded in both restoration modes; expected widgets, INT types and exported links verified. No extra cases added to full regression totals.
